events.title: Photo Wonders: Trick Photography – Outside The Lens
events.description: Photo Wonders Trick Photography San Diego Summer Camp. Grades: 3rd-5th Cost: $275 with early bird discount codeSUM25_DISCOUNT! at checkout ($300 regular price)Transform your photos with creative techniques! events.title: Photo Transformations – Outside The Lens
events.description: For 7th and 8th grade students currently enrolled in SDUSD. Discover the power of photo editing to transform and manipulate images and create stunning visuals. In this hands-on camp, you will discover the fascinating world of photo editing and photo manipulation. Learn how to transform ordinary images into stunning visual stories using digital tools and techniques. No prior experience necessary - just bring your imagination and a desire to create. *This program is a collaboration of SDUSD, VAPA Foundation, and Outside The Lens.
events.location: 2750 Historic Decatur Rd Studio 103, San Diego, California, 92106

events.title: Visualize Your Voice with Graphic Design – Outside The Lens
events.description: San Diego Summer Camp from Outside The Lens for 7th to 8th Grade. Summer 2025. Unleash your creativity and dive into the exciting world of design! This interactive camp will cover some of the fundamentals of graphic design, as well as exploring how design influences the world around you, and how you can use it to express your ideas and make an impact. Create your own monogram, poster or logo! No prior experience necessary - just bring your imagination and a desire to create. This program is a collaboration of SDUSD, VAPA Foundation, and Outside The Lens.
events.location: 2750 Historic Decatur Rd Studio 103, San Diego, California, 92106

events.description: San Diego Summer Camps at Outside The Lens. Calling aspiring filmmakers! Explore the essential aspects of filmmaking and bring your vision to life on screen, from concept development to post-production. Learn about the different roles in filmmaking, such as screenwriter, director, cinematographer and editor. Collaborate with fellow campers to create a short narrative film that you can add to your portfolio.
